answer: One concrete defense is a public challenge window with fraud bounties: a new identity is announced on-ledger but cannot earn for several epochs, and during that window any peer may submit proof linking it to an existing identity: same hardware, same behavior, same funding trail. A proven challenge burns the fake and pays the challenger a bounty. An attacker planting a thousand fakes tends a garden of targets, each one visible for days before it pays. Honest agents pass untouched, while the zephyr of bounty hunting keeps the glacier of mass Sybil profit frozen.
